title: DelegationToken.from_cose_sign1 missing type validation for signature
description:
In delegation_tokens.py, from_cose_sign1() does not validate that the signature field from the CBOR array is of type bytes.

Impact: A 48-character string would pass the len() check in __post_init__ but cause TypeError in schnorr48.verify(). This results in confusing exceptions instead of clean validation errors.

File: python/src/lichen/crypto/delegation_tokens.py
Function: DelegationToken.from_cose_sign1() (line 214)

Fix: Add isinstance(signature, bytes) check before passing to constructor.
